_description: Respiratory Triage Checklist scenario — form payload for tests/respiratory-triage.spec.ts. Filled into the Respiratory Triage create form (load/form/{patientId}/respiratory-triage?display=create, opened via the 'Add New' button on the Respiratory Triage tab of the visit edit page). The target visit ID is read from config/config.json (visitId) to reach the tab; the patient ID comes from the 'Add New' href itself (appointment.targetPatientIdentifier). Static values are chosen from the real radio values/labels on staging: dialysis radio uses the id-mapped labels 'Yes'/'No', disposition radios (iso/er/opd) use the raw values 'yes'/'no'. The hidden signature signed_by/signed_at fields (set by the signature pad) are intentionally absent.

_config._comment: No extra test parameters — the scenario is the form payload only.
